items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: There was Eugene Wright, Eugene Wright and his Dukes of Swing... So I stayed with them fellas.

ctx.x: Yeah, things didn't straighten out. First I started carrying mail out of the old post office. But I got a little break. There came a call for a trombone player and they didn't know I was an old man and I didn't know these young kids. There was Eugene Wright, Eugene Wright and his Dukes of Swing. So they had, I'd say 90% of the gigs around there. And they had so much work. And I was carrying mail out of the old post office. I'd just lay my uniform on the bed when I reached, when I came home, you know. And it…
Then you gave up the post office after all.
